reason: I run 11-20 techs and maybe two locations on a POS that mostly works. A brand-new company asking to sit at my desk on a Saturday is a lot of risk for me. If they close, my client list and tech pay records go with them.
objection: Who are you? A new company could close and take my data. I have too many techs and too much money going through the desk to be someone's guinea pig.
would_change_my_mind: Another salon my size, running it for a year or more, who I can call myself, plus a written promise that my data comes back if they shut down.
